Title: [LSJ] Blood Dolling for fun and profit

Messages.Author: Charles Lechasseur
Messages.Body:
A question to settle a bet with a friend. :)

Player A controls Carna, the Princess Witch. Carna has a Derange on her
that makes her a Malkavian, as well as a Blood Doll.

During his master phase, Player B plays Malkavian Dementia to take control
of Carna.

Can Player B use Carna's Blood Doll to immediately transfer a blood from
Carna to his pool? My guess is yes because Blood Doll says "this vampire's
controller may move 1 blood...".

Card text on Blood Doll:

Name: Blood Doll
Cardtype: Master
Master.
Put this card on a vampire you control. During his or her master phase,
this vampire's controller may move 1 blood from this vampire to his or her
pool or from his or her pool to this vampire.

--
charles lechasseur - da...@novideospamtron.ca

yes, of course. You are B : Your master phase is still going on, even if you
already used all your master phase actions. You are free to do or trigger
whatever should be done or triggered during your master phase =)
then you may move on to your minion phase at some point. We hate stalling,
remember ? ;)
